opportunities.title: NEH Collections Stewardship (December 2026)

timing_evidence.detail: The notice lists December 15, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern for the second deadline.

opportunities.description: Preservation and access to physical or digital humanities collections, libraries and archives.
opportunities.eligibility: Applications are submitted by eligible organizations; a researcher needs an eligible institutional applicant.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Find an eligible museum, archive or university organizational lead; check the current NEH Notice of Funding Opportunity.

opportunities.title: NEH Endowments for Advancing the Humanities
opportunities.description: Support for long-term humanities teaching and research infrastructure through organizational endowments.
opportunities.eligibility: Organizational applications with major nonfederal matching-fund requirements; not an individual fellowship.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Coordinate with university or museum leadership and verify the matching-fund requirement.

opportunities.title: NSF Major Research Instrumentation (MRI) — January 2027 window
opportunities.description: Acquisition or development of major research instrumentation for scientific and engineering research.
opportunities.eligibility: Eligible U.S. institutions and some research organizations submit on behalf of research teams; window opens January 4, 2027.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Identify an institution-authorized proposal team and equipment needs, then check NSF 27-500.

opportunities.title: DFG Walter Benjamin Programme
opportunities.description: Postdoctoral qualification-stage research position or fellowship in Germany or abroad, with host support.
opportunities.eligibility: Early-phase postdocs only. Special German academic-system integration restrictions apply to fellowships outside Germany.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Verify early-postdoc status and German academic-system rules; secure host acceptance.

opportunities.title: DFG Individual Research Grants
opportunities.description: Supports defined original research projects by qualified researchers in all disciplines.
opportunities.eligibility: As a rule doctorate holders working at German research institutions; commercial-only institutions excluded.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Confirm qualified investigator status and German host institution requirements.

opportunities.title: Spencer Foundation Small Research Grants on Education
opportunities.description: Field-initiated research on education and learning across settings; two competitions per year.
opportunities.eligibility: Investigators must satisfy current proposal and institutional criteria; current submission window not confirmed.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Verify the next published application cycle, PI rules, and eligible applicant institution.

opportunities.title: UKRI/MRC Impact Acceleration Award — Translation
opportunities.description: Translation award to de-risk a medical product, diagnostic, device or therapy.
opportunities.eligibility: Requires an eligible UK research organization and translation-specific scope.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Find an eligible UK MRC host and inspect the program-specific call and closing time.

opportunities.title: USDA NIFA Hispanic-Serving Institutions Education Grants
opportunities.description: Strengthens eligible Hispanic-Serving Institutions through teaching, applied research and related programs.
opportunities.eligibility: Only eligible U.S. Hispanic-serving institutions may apply. Confirm the institution’s designation under the official call.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Confirm that your institution is an eligible HSI and review current NIFA NOFO.

opportunities.title: ERC Consolidator Grant 2027
opportunities.description: Independent frontier research across disciplines with an eligible host in the EU or associated countries.
opportunities.eligibility: Principal investigators typically 5–15 years since PhD, with eligible extensions; host eligibility and time commitments apply.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Confirm 5–15 years after PhD and secure an eligible European host; check extensions and current call.

opportunities.title: NSF Engineering Core Research: CBET
opportunities.description: Core engineering proposals in chemical, bioengineering, energy and transport systems, generally accepted at any time.
opportunities.eligibility: Institutional proposal under NSF core programs; specific call, budget and PI requirements must be confirmed.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Check which CBET program fits the project and contact its program officer. Confirm submission eligibility with your grants office.

opportunities.title: ARC Discovery Projects — 2028 commencement (forecast)
opportunities.amount: A$30,000–A$500,000 per year, up to 5 years
opportunities.description: Australian fundamental and applied research across non-medical disciplines, supporting projects and teams.
opportunities.eligibility: Eligible Australian research institutions submit; 2028 programme uses updated rules. This listing is not confirmation of a currently open call.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Check 2028 ARC guidelines and your institution eligibility; ARC Discovery excludes clinical/medical research.

opportunities.title: AHRC Catalyst Awards — Emerging Research Leaders
opportunities.description: Applicant-led research support for researchers without experience of leading a significant project.
opportunities.eligibility: Applicant must be based at an organization eligible for AHRC funding in the UK. Career and team details require checking.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Confirm UK eligible host, project-lead criteria and 80% FEC funding conditions.

opportunities.title: AHRC Standard Research Grant — Applicant-Led
opportunities.description: Larger collaborative humanities, arts and interdisciplinary research projects, with at least two team leads.
opportunities.eligibility: Project lead at UK AHRC-eligible research institution; international co-leads allowed under rules.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Find UK institutional project lead and qualified co-lead; verify research scope and FEC conditions.

opportunities.title: AHRC International Placement Scheme 2027
opportunities.description: Two- to five-month international research placements at participating archives, libraries and research institutions.
opportunities.eligibility: AHRC-supported doctoral researchers and other specified UK early-career applicants; check precise current eligibility.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Check AHRC funding history or UK institutional eligibility and approved placement host.

opportunities.title: NEH Fellowships — 2027 Competition
opportunities.description: Fellowships paid to individual humanities scholars; 2027 application access is scheduled for January 15.
opportunities.eligibility: Historical 2026 subject restrictions may differ from 2027. Verify scope and individual eligibility when application opens.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Recheck 2027 NEH guidelines on January 15; do not assume every humanities topic is eligible.

opportunities.title: British Academy ECR Network Seed Fund 2026–27
opportunities.amount: Small seed funding; see member guidelines
opportunities.description: Nine-month ECR-led network seed projects, only for qualifying British Academy ECR Network members.
opportunities.eligibility: Both lead and co-applicant must be eligible British Academy ECRN members, have attended three events and meet prior funding cap.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Confirm ECRN membership, event history and total grant awards in preceding two years.

opportunities.title: FAPESP Young Investigator Grant for International Researchers
opportunities.amount: Up to 60 months; see official rules
opportunities.description: International young investigators starting independent research in São Paulo in selected strategic areas.
opportunities.eligibility: Must currently live abroad and have lived and worked outside Brazil for at least two years after PhD; future São Paulo host needed.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Confirm post-PhD work abroad, a São Paulo host and fit to one of the seven strategic research themes.

opportunities.title: NSF Engineering Research Initiation (ERI) 2027
opportunities.description: Engineering research initiation awards for faculty investigators at qualifying U.S. non-R1 institutions.
opportunities.eligibility: PI must meet early federal funding thresholds and non-R1 U.S. institution restriction; R1 faculty are not eligible.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Confirm non-R1 institution status, doctoral qualification and prior federal PI funding history.

opportunities.title: NEH Fellowships for Advanced Social Science Research on Japan — 2027
opportunities.description: Individual scholar fellowships for advanced social-science research on Japan; opens January 15, 2027.
opportunities.eligibility: Specialized Japan social sciences; verify scholar and subject eligibility in published 2027 program guidance.

eligibility_rules.next_step: Check topic and nationality/institution requirements when 2027 call opens.

limitations: Curated sample of official 2026–27 program pages across fields. Not exhaustive. No sponsor eligibility approval or continuous monitoring is implied.
